book.spectrum.guidebook.syncbook.name: The Syncbook
book.spectrum.guidebook.syncbook.page0.t:
The Syncbook is a item that allows you to share your spectrum progress with others.\
Use it to fill it with knowledge.
book.spectrum.guidebook.syncbook.page1.t: But how do I use this

The Syncbook will [#](449900)glow[#]() when it is holding spectrum progress. simply right-click to get the progress.\
Or if you want to overwrite the progress in the book you can [#](449900)Sneak and use[#]() to put your progress in the book
